core_obligations: Part (1) (proof lines 619-630): the author shows that the restriction of an injective module is injective, using the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction and the extension property of injective modules.

Part (2) (proof lines 630-638): the identification of the cohomology of a sheaf on C/U with the cohomology of its restriction at U follows from part (1), since an injective resolution restricts to an injective resolution.
proof_roadmap: Prove that restriction preserves injectives via the adjunction and the extension property.
Use an injective resolution to identify the cohomology on the localized site with the cohomology at U.
difficulty_reason: The lemma has two parts: the restriction of an injective module to a localized site is injective, and the cohomology of a sheaf on the localized site agrees with its cohomology at the object (statement lines 607-617). The first part is proved through the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction together with the extension property of injectives (proof lines 619-630); the second follows by restricting an injective resolution, which stays injective by the first part (proof lines 630-638). The non-formal content is the adjunction argument in part (1). The claim is H2: one adjunction argument plus one immediate consequence.
